bio: A successful restaurant with a long-standing tradition located at the entrance to the exclusive La Moraleja residential development, where you’ll find a contemporary maritime-inspired interior and a verdant terrace that is highly recommended when the weather allows. The à la carte here specialises in fish and seafood (note the enticing display cabinet featuring large, line-caught fish, many of which are big enough for two). This is complemented by a choice of cold cuts, tartares, fried and rice dishes, as delicious dishes, red meats such as suckling lamb....
